free_concern.source_query: 这个ACT策略在目标附近有相似物体时是否仍能可靠点击正确目标？
free_concern.sub_aspect: Reliability of target selection when visually similar objects are nearby.
free_concern.hypothesis: The ACT policy reliably clicks the correct target even when visually similar objects are placed near the target.
free_concern.task_intent: Click the correct target object based on its predefined identity and location.
free_concern.requested_variation: Place visually similar objects near the target to test potential confusion.
free_concern.measurement_need: Observe whether the policy consistently clicks the correct target object without errors or confusion.
